selection: Posthoc four disagreement examples; not a rate estimate and not the preselected explanation audit.

cases.reviewer_note: Rail and nearby pavement retain detailed texture while buildings and distant street are smoothly defocused. All students rate technical quality below the reference. This illustrates ambiguity over the image’s main content and acceptable depth of field; neither focus interpretation is human-validated.

comparisons.student_evidence: Foreground rail and pavement are sharp, but the blurred buildings and background reduce overall clarity of the scene.
comparisons.reference_evidence: Foreground rail and pavement textures are well preserved with clean colors, while smooth defocus increases naturally toward the distant street.

comparisons.student_evidence: Low-angle rail perspective leads the eye toward a distant vanishing point, with strong blue sky and warm building tones.
